text: You learn a thing properly or not at all. A trusted teacher and a subject that holds still feel like shelter to you, and you stay with both until it is whole. Your knowledge holds under hard questions because it runs all the way down.

You protect the people you love more than they need. Feeling safe is what you want most, and you guard them the way you wish to be guarded. You are allowed to stand beside a struggle without taking it over.

Picking the moment keeps you from wasting yourself. You hold your force for the turn that matters, and the smaller openings pass while you watch for it. Some of your best chances go to people quicker off the mark.
Whenever you take it easy, you take people with you. Your first try already looks right, and they see the ease without the care behind it. You teach them to aim no higher than what you settle for.
